improvements: Current native scene retains 318 source building records and validates the source geometry cache; no membership count establishes architectural parity.
Physical exterior approach; three manual public-island shutters
The selected primary activity approach is accepted separately from full-scene comparison.
District fidelity pass, 451c5f9 (range 332ae423..346f7986): Invented shopfronts were removed, the park canopy was added, the arch is visible from Kiseleff and the de Gaulle statue was added.

Fidelity pass round 3, 2b1a251 (range 9824fd56..2b1a2511): Inscription read-points with sourced texts (east and west swapped back), light grey Kiseleff lamps and the Arcul woods at full density (3,221 trees, far-canopy crowns).
remainingGaps: Actual crossing safety/reference review remains separate; no rooftop visit
Complete matched independent scene, entry and architectural/reference comparison remains open; source membership and cache hits are not visual parity.
Route/controller proof does not certify every secondary activity, completed-save persistence or full phone-thumbstick coverage.

Validation frames, native proofs, source-geometry counts and performance figures in this record predate 2b1a251 and were not re-run for round 3.

visitorGallery.notice: 4 matched walking-height viewpoints in each of four conditions, recaptured from game source 2b1a251 after fidelity pass round 3. Open any picture at its original size.
visitorGallery.setup: Production app, scene, actors, lighting and renderer at High quality, 1280 × 800. Automatic animation was paused and explicit frames rendered at fixed on-foot cameras 1.65 m above their supporting surfaces. Local simulation dates and weather were controlled; capturedAt records the real capture time.
limitations: Fixed on-foot appearance fixtures; cameras were positioned for inspection. These pictures do not establish a traversed route, activity completion, physical-phone behavior or hardware FPS.
Viewpoint ids, positions, look and field of view are those of the 346f798 gallery.
Night conditions are taken after the scene's night-light fade completed (recorded nightK = 1 for every night picture).
The captured High-quality frames reach 477,754 triangles / 190 draw calls, within the 1.5 M triangle / 400 draw-call frame budget in these frames.
Headless Chromium (Playwright), ANGLE Direct3D 11 on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 (hardware GL, audio muted).
